title: Createive Gate Result
description: One evaluated Gate, recorded against the Phase that declared it. Records what was claimed, by whom, and which existing files back it; it is not proof the Gate ran. A recorded pass is self-attestation until a runner produces the evidence itself.

recordedBy.description: The agent that evaluated the Gate. May not equal waiver.approvedBy.

evidenceRefs.description: Paths, relative to the Run root or the workspace root, that back this verdict. Checked for existence when recorded.

validUntil.description: When this verdict stops counting. Evidence is perishable: a result expires because the world moved, not because the Run ended. Absent means it does not expire on its own.

waiver.description: Required when status is waived. Uses the vocabulary of framework/templates/project/EXCEPTIONS.md: scope, reason, Evidence (evidenceRefs above), owner (approvedBy), revisit condition, and whether it is reusable.

scope.description: project is representable but rejected at record time: a project-wide waiver is a policy change and belongs in a Lock.
